data_roles.state_history: Big5 2014-2022 completed history strictly prior to target date snapshot

feature.definition: For each team over its latest 8 clean completed league matches, compute 90*(nonpenalty xG_for+xG_against while tied)/tied_minutes minus 90*(nonpenalty xG_for+xG_against over all score states)/all_minutes; match feature is the arithmetic mean of home and away team values.
feature.interpretation: Negative values mean the pair historically suppresses nonpenalty chance activity specifically while level relative to its own overall match-state activity.
feature.own_goal_rule: Goal credits event h_a; OwnGoal credits opposite event h_a

method.model: offset logistic on Frozen Stage6 B draw probability
method.score_matrix_rule: region-rescale Frozen Stage6 B score matrix to candidate 1X2 while preserving within-result-region shape

nonduplication.historical_fusion_v3_shot_regime: V3 uses rolling overall shot/xG quality, open-play/set-piece composition and finishing/keeper residuals; this feature is a within-team contrast conditioned on prior score state tied versus all states.
nonduplication.c070g_state_duration: C070G models within-match state-duration transitions after kickoff; this candidate uses only completed prior matches to form a prematch team response profile.
nonduplication.chance_burstiness: Chance burstiness uses timing-bin concentration irrespective of score state; this candidate conditions prior xG activity on tied state.
nonduplication.r43af1_residual_volatility: R43AF1 uses residual second moments/RMSE; this candidate uses state-conditioned chance intensity contrast.

after_pass.next: find and preregister a genuinely unconsumed historical confirmation cohort before label scoring
